system.description: You gather flames in your palm and let them loose. Make a Spellcast Roll against a target within Very Far range. On a success, mark 3 Stress to hurl a sphere of fire toward them that explodes on impact. The target and all creatures within Very Close range of them must make a Reaction Roll (15). Targets who fail take 1d20+5 magic damage. Targets who succeed take half damage.
